item.title: Topic Overview
item.description: Spiking Neural Networks Spiking Neural Networks, or SNNs, are neural networks that compute with discrete spike events instead of continuously passing dense numerical activations from layer to layer.

item.title: 3.3 Spike Count as Activity Cost
item.description: A spike event gives a spiking neural network a very simple kind of message: at a particular time step, a particular neuron either fires or stays silent.
